data.name: AgentText.ServiceMissingCause
data.value: thermi's sensor service is not installed on this PC, so nothing reads the sensors.

data.name: AgentText.ServiceMissingFix
data.value: Ask the person to install thermi, or its sensors alone, from https://github.com/claudiopi/thermi/releases.

data.name: AgentText.ServiceStoppedCause
data.value: thermi's sensor service is installed but not running.

data.name: AgentText.ServiceStoppedFix
data.value: Ask the person to choose Start sensors in thermi's menu, which asks for administrator rights once. Do not start it yourself.

data.name: AgentText.ServiceStaleCause
data.value: thermi's sensor service runs, but has sent no readings for a few seconds.

data.name: AgentText.ServiceStaleFix
data.value: Wait a few seconds and read again; Windows restarts the service if it stays stuck.

data.name: AgentText.PipeTakenCause
data.value: Another program holds the name of thermi's sensor pipe, so its readings cannot be trusted.

data.name: AgentText.PipeTakenFix
data.value: Ask the person to restart the PC, or to close the program that took the pipe's name.

data.name: AgentText.DriverMissingCause
data.value: The CPU's temperature, power and clock read zero: the driver that reads them may be missing.

data.name: AgentText.DriverMissingFix
data.value: Ask the person to open thermi's settings, where it offers to install the driver, with administrator rights once.

data.name: AgentText.SettingsBrokenCause
data.value: thermi's settings file cannot be used, so no change can be written to it.

data.name: AgentText.SettingsBrokenFix
data.value: Ask the person to fix the file, or to choose Restore last good settings in thermi's settings window.

data.name: AgentText.ServiceStoppedFixSensorsOnly
data.value: Ask the person to start the thermi-sensors service in Windows' Services, as administrator, or to run thermi's installer again. Do not start it yourself.

data.name: AgentText.DriverMissingFixSensorsOnly
data.value: Ask the person to run thermi's installer again, which installs the driver with administrator rights once.

data.name: AgentText.SettingsBrokenFixSensorsOnly
data.value: Ask the person to fix or delete thermi's settings file, %APPDATA%\thermi\config.json.

data.name: AgentText.NotRunningCause
data.value: thermi isn't running: it is installed for this person alone, and its sensors are read only while thermi runs.

data.name: AgentText.NotRunningFix
data.value: Ask the person to start thermi from the Start menu. Do not start it yourself.
